messages:
viv: quick note — encountered multiple parity issues when swapping REST -> SDK (js v0.8.1) in our streaming quickstart.
tan: details?
viv: minimal repro: REST curl with `stream:true` + `temperature` works and will auto-retry if token expires mid-stream. SDK call `client.generate({model:'redwood-rt-1', input, stream:true, temp:0.3})` behaves differently: 1) SDK sometimes ignores `stream:true` in one code path, 2) parameter names are inconsistent (`temperature` vs `temp`, `max_new_tokens` vs `maxTokens`), 3) auth refresh during streaming does not reconnect — stream dies.
claire: oof. sample apps probably copy REST examples and break. Which sample?
viv: `examples/streaming-quickstart` README shows REST param names; folks paste that into SDK client examples and hit silent failures.
oscar: is there an idempotency key we can use to replay the stream?
tan: yes, `request_id` is accepted by the service. REST + our internal clients use it to resume. SDK isn't wiring it into reconnect logic.
viv: repro steps I used: create a short-lived token, start a generation that yields ~800 tokens, let token expire ~mid-stream. REST clients log a 401 chunk, refresh token, and continue. SDK shows `Error: stream closed (401)` and application-level failure.
claire: aside — telemetry loses signal if param names diverge. Our metrics expect canonical names.
oscar: proposed fixes: 1) add compatibility aliasing in SDK input parser mapping REST names -> SDK internals (temperature->temp, max_new_tokens->maxTokens, top_p->topP) with one-time warning; 2) implement streaming auth-refresh reconnect using `request_id` replay; 3) add opt-out config `streamingRetry: false` for users who prefer fail-fast.
tan: +1. Also add unit/integration tests that force-expire tokens mid-stream and assert reconnect.
viv: will add a tiny test in examples CI: `ci/test_stream_reconnect.sh` that simulates auth expiry.
claire: can we emit telemetry events `sdk_alias_used` and `sdk_stream_reconnect_attempt` so Console can show how often aliasing/reconnects happen?
oscar: yes, add events and a short-lived Grafana dashboard for canary.
build-bot: issue #543 created by tan: "SDK parity: streaming reconnect + parameter aliases + examples"
build-bot: Issue #543: https://redwood/issue/543
tan: plan: patch branch, implement aliasing shim + reconnect logic behind opt-out flag, tests + example update, canary rollout for 48h, then patch release 0.8.2.
viv: thanks — i've added a failing example to catch regressions. If anyone sees other naming mismatches (embeddings, rerank), drop them here and i'll collate. :sparkles:
